title: a registry line written at schema v1 (preset keys) is an invalid line for every reader: close, analyze, launch --parent, reap, tree and the SessionEnd hook see no launch, and nothing is written
source: intended: docs/decisions.md registry v2 decision (defect N-31); the oracle reads and writes v: 1 lines
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-31, owner answer A6). The registry log is schema v2: a line with `v: 1` is an invalid line like any other, skipped by every reader. The one line of the project is a complete v1 launch line, so `close <id>`, `analyze <id>` and `launch --parent <id>` answer that the id is unknown (exit 2, no orca call), `reap` ends nothing and counts zero, `tree` prints `jitso tree: no launches`, the SessionEnd hook of the line's session appends nothing, and the file keeps its one line. The oracle reads the v1 line as a valid launch, so its first step closes the launch (exit 0) and the case FAILS on TS.

stderr: JITSO REJECTED: unknown parent launch L20261113T142233-a3f9

stdout.regex: (?m)^jitso reap: 0 launch\(es\) marked ended, 0 unlogged worker\(s\), 0 analyzed$
